name: EntityHeader
description: A responsive page heading for an entity, with identity, status, supporting metadata and host-defined actions.
signature: ({ icon, iconStatus, title, status, subtitle, actions, tabs, ...rest }: EntityHeaderProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: iconStatus
props.description: A StatusDot on the icon's corner.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: Data only: model, owner, path. Never a description of the page.

props.name: children
props.description: The content or component slots rendered inside the component.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.
